name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement to Reaper
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Problem

What language or developer workflow is difficult or unreliable today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the syntax, runtime behavior, editor action, or CLI workflow from the user's point of view.

## Compatibility

Explain effects on existing programs, parser behavior, tree-walk and VM parity, native C17 support, and tooling protocols.

## Boundaries

State whether the proposal requires FFI, filesystem access, process access, or external services. Explain how existing execution limits and opt-in boundaries remain intact.

## Acceptance checks

List examples, diagnostics, tests, and observable results that would demonstrate completion.
